notes: First Alpha build for testers. Expect rough edges, and please report what you find.
Pop-up decks on a trigger key, with press, hold and stay-open behaviours.
Actions: text, shortcut, open (app, file or folder), website, media and draggable volume, mouse click, system, and sequences of those.
Visual editor with layouts up to 20 × 12, about 2,200 icons, image icons, colours, and JSON import/export.
Fully offline, with a 7-day free trial and offline license activation.
